text:
Two questions we get a lot: when do I take it, and how?

Tear one stick, stir it into 200 to 250 ml of water, and sip. SILT Mornings goes any time in the morning. SILT Nights works best 30 to 60 minutes before bed, so it's already in you when your head hits the pillow.
